integrity: The infinite result is proved analytically. The embedded verifier independently reconstructs the D-conflict relation and supplies finite stress tests of the structural decomposition, exact formula, explicit construction, and equality condition; finite checks are not used as a proof of the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite simple complete multipartite graphs and does not settle the universal D-chromatic-index conjecture. The bipartite and complete-graph endpoint cases are already implied by prior work; the new content is the arbitrary multipartite conflict decomposition and exact formula. Search-based originality checks cannot exclude poorly indexed or unpublished equivalents.
title: Exact D-chromatic index of complete multipartite graphs
